notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
[h1] PATCH NOTES (1.05) [/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a tutorial to help familiarise new players to the game
[*] Added a selection of new characters (Shark, Panda, Fox, Raccoon, Croc)
[*] Fixed a number of small UI and animation bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
[h1]PATCH NOTES (1.02) [/h1]

Another small patch to fix some little issues some of you guys brought to our attention.
[list]
[*] Fixes to the pinball (May cause issues with existing saves, deleting and replacing should fix).
[*] Fixes to certain objects not saving correctly.
[*] Fixes to audio settings.
[*] Cleaned up and added new animations.

[/list]
Thanks guys.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
[h1] PATCH NOTES (1.01) [/h1]

Hey guys just a small post-launch patch for bug fixes and the like. Expect more patches and updates in the coming weeks.
[list]
[*] Misc UI fixes
[*] Audio mixing improvements
[*] Save and load improvements
[*] Fixed missing Cat animations
[*] Added 1440p resolution option
[*] Removed rollovers
[*] Low funds notification added
[*] Fixed missing object descriptions
[*] Improved floor textures
[/list]

notes.title: We're Released!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!
Coin-Op Kingdom is now released for you all to enjoy. We've thrown a 33% discount for the first week to celebrate the launch. We hope you enjoy the game!

Join our  [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/QZC9HhV]Discord [/url] to meet the team and leave us feedback or post it here on Steam. We appreciate all of you that have encouraged us to make this, we hope you have fun!

notes.title: Community Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, 
We're getting real close to the release of Coin-Op Kingdom and should have a new trailer for you guys soon!

In the meantime, we're hard at work getting Coin-Op Kingdom ready for you guys and we would like your help! If you're interested in getting a sneak peak into the development, or just fancy talking with some of the devs, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/QZC9HhV] Discord[/url] We may even have some keys to give away!

If that doesn't strike your fancy, you can always follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/coinopkingdom] Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/CoinOpKingdom] Facebook[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/CoinOpKingdom] Instagram[/url].

We'll have more news for you soon!
